Only cs5FC (:159) and cs5FC'' (:184) are in CKExtension.lean. Still worth correcting in a future plan revision; non-blocking.

An intermediate docstring I wrote asserted that Context 'would fail to compile' if GeomAxiom were later extended with an existential axiom. That is FALSE — Context would compile fine and simply not constrain it; the actual forcing function is GeomAxiom.Holds's EXHAUSTIVE MATCH (and TClosure), which is what forces a decision at the point of extension. Caught during self-review and corrected before commit. Recorded because shipping a plausible-but-false rationale is precisely the defect class (defect 4) this phase exists to remove — the fix would have been self-defeating otherwise.

With clause 3 deleted, NO field of Context mentions 𝒯 — a context is now genuinely theory-independent. The 𝒯 parameter is RETAINED as an index and documented as such in the Context docstring, because TPrime extends Context 𝒯 Atom and IS 𝒯-relative (clause 0 plus every Deriv 𝒯 clause), and Context.le / the Zorn poset thread a fixed 𝒯. lake lint's unusedArguments does NOT flag it (structure parameters are not checked the way def arguments are). Removing the index would be a separate, larger refactor touching Context.le, the LE/Preorder instances, and TPrime — deliberately out of this phase's scope per the plan's task list and plan-compliance rules. Flagged so a future reviewer does not read the unused parameter as an oversight.
